sections.title: How NFC business cards work

Tap the card against any modern smartphone — it opens your link instantly, no app needed.

faq.question: Do NFC business cards work with all phones?
faq.answer: Yes. All iPhones from iPhone 7 onward and virtually all Android phones support NFC tap. No app is required — the card opens your URL in the phone's default browser.

faq.question: Can each card have a different URL?
faq.answer: Yes. We can program each card with a unique URL, which is ideal for teams where each person has their own profile page or vCard link.

faq.question: What is your reseller pricing?
faq.answer: Contact us for volume pricing. We offer tiered discounts starting from 200 pcs, with white-label packaging and custom branding for resellers.
